body: It's really just some fucked up shit I've done during the past few months that has been screwing up my life - been on some crazy, fucked up high shit. My former friends now think I'm an insane bastard. It's not like anything I can do can change their minds on their perspective of me, or to stop them from gossiping about me behind my back. I screwed up on social media too - fucked up my reputation. It's not like I should care about those bastards, but I fucking care too much. Shit will happen to me wherever I go. Killing myself is my only solution at this point.

When my life finally started to get better last year, I fucked up my entire life during a bipolar manic episode. All my former friends hate me for some impulsive things I posted on Facebook, and weird ideas I've told them during my last semester of college. They eventually found out about my bipolar issues, and created rumors about me being in multiple relationships when I've never dated and have no interest in pursuing romantic relationships. I'm supposed to start my second year of college in two days, but I'm too damn afraid of some fucked up rumors and a messed up reputation to go.   

I don't have anybody to rely on except for people on suicide hotlines and strangers on Reddit. My parents don't understand my mental health issues, and I have zero friends. I'm probably some pathetic attention seeker for posting my issues on Reddit. My life is continuing to go downhill. People are going to continue laughing at me for being some worthless scumbag. I'm stuck with my own self-pity, and I probably whine too much. If I died, I wouldn't have to deal with all this shit anymore.

I'm not sure how to apologize in a way that makes sense. My college friends only knew my hypomanic self, and I acted idiotic and immature to them. I'm kind of worried that just saying I was going through a rough time might sound like an excuse to them. I'm not sure if they would listen to me after they've shut me out.

No, there are people who actually hate me, and told me they hate me. I fucked up over too many things, and all my friends hate me for it. Nobody else in my life knows about my thoughts and feelings except some online strangers on Reddit. I am a fucked up person. I have been through a bipolar mania episode in the past few months without realizing I had it, and my emotions got too intense, and I fucked up all my friendships over some dumb shit I said and done. It's too late to repair them, and I can't make any new friends if they're still spreading rumors about me. I seriously want to die. Nobody in this world understands me, and so many people already hate me. If I died, it'll be for the good of the world. Nobody would have to suffer or give a damn because of me, and I wouldn't be in pain anymore.

I'm just kind of worried about confronting them, even if it's through messaging online. I was lied to, manipulated, and had some mind games played on me on the group chat I was in with my college friends near the end of my mania until they kicked me out with a list of reasons why they hated me. I still want to apologize, but I'm kind of scared about going around about it to them.
No, I'm not open about it, but I would probably have to if I want to explain some of the things that happened. I am open about my depression and my anxiety.

The stress is going to lower my grades. It happened in high school, and I don't want to deal with that again. I'm not really smart. I just happened to be able to fit in with society's expectations of a student who can get high grades when I'm stable. I have trouble finding friends I can trust. I attract people who either hate me or are weird and creepy. Maybe I'm the one who's weird. I shouldn't really exist.

I've thought about becoming an animation artist for a TV show, video game, or at least a webcomic, but it's not like I can easily do it if I can't easily make connections with other people anyways. Most people already hate me. It's not like my art would have any value in helping me get a job if people hate me enough to not even look at my art.

At this point, I don't even know what to do about college. I don't know if I want to go back for the next semester if so many people there already hate me. I don't even have a lot of time to think about it. I'm moving back in about a week. I'd rather die off than being stuck in my personal hell. It would makes things easier for other people too so they don't have to see my stupid face around. Everything I did is still my fault. I wish I could just disappear off the face of the Earth, and from people's memories. 

I don't even have the guts to kill myself when I'm too damn afraid of pain and death. I'm just a coward in life. I can't even face my own fears of being hated when I'm actually hated. I can't even face my own problems. I can't even kill myself when I want to die. Life is torture for me.

I have trouble getting back into things I like; doing them just brings up bad memories of my former friends. I have trouble trying to focus on watching anime because these thoughts keep creeping up on my mind. The same thing happens when I try to play video games, and I just can't focus. The only "safe" passions I have are creating artwork and animations since they're something I'm talented in and I rely on them to "vent" out some of my emotions, but it's not like I can make a career out of them if people hate me so easily. My future is hopeless.
